status_definitions.verified: The roadmap output and exit gate are supported by implementation, automated tests and current evidence; no user-facing surface is required unless the step defines one.
status_definitions.partial: One or more code, contract, API, persistence, authorization, audit, UI, integration-test or runtime-evidence obligations remain open.
status_definitions.gated: A safe contract or record-only implementation exists, but operational verification needs a separately authorized external, secret, destructive or Production action.
status_definitions.owner_pending: Implementation exists but the roadmap explicitly requires an Owner decision that an agent cannot self-issue.
status_definitions.deferred: The step is intentionally held until its declared prerequisite is accepted.
